dashboard.label: Lateral Movement
dashboard.description: RDP, WinRM, SMB, PsExec, WMI, scheduled tasks, and service installation detection

search.query: index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4624 Logon_Type=3 | where NOT match(Account_Name, "(?i)(ANONYMOUS LOGON|\$|DWM-|UMFD-)") | table _time, host, Account_Name, Source_Network_Address, Authentication_Package | sort -_time
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4624 Logon_Type=10 | table _time, host, Account_Name, Source_Network_Address | sort -_time
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:WinRM" | table _time, host, EventCode, Message | sort -_time
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:WMI" | table _time, host, EventCode, Message | sort -_time
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" (EventCode=5140 OR EventCode=5145) | table _time, host, Account_Name, Source_Address, Share_Name, Relative_Target_Name, Access_Mask | sort -_time

(index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4697) OR (index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:System" EventCode=7045) | table _time, host, EventCode, Account_Name, Service_Name, Service_File_Name, Service_Type, Service_Start_Type | sort -_time
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4698 | table _time, host, Account_Name, Task_Name, Task_Content | sort -_time
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=8 | table _time, host, SourceImage, TargetImage, SourceProcessId, TargetProcessId, StartFunction | sort -_time
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=10 | where match(TargetImage, "(?i)lsass\.exe") | table _time, host, SourceImage, TargetImage, GrantedAccess, SourceProcessId | sort -_time

panel.title: PowerShell Script Block Logging - Suspicious Keywords

search.query: index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:PowerShell" EventCode=4104 | search ScriptBlockText IN ("*Invoke-Mimikatz*", "*Invoke-Expression*", "*DownloadString*", "*IEX*", "*Net.WebClient*", "*Start-Process*", "*Invoke-Command*", "*Enter-PSSession*", "*New-PSSession*", "*Invoke-WmiMethod*", "*-EncodedCommand*", "*FromBase64*", "*bypass*") | table _time, host, ScriptBlockText | sort -_time
